checks: Blocked, flagged, and unexpected moderation decisions prevent post creation and session linking.
The flagged moderation case displays that the post was not published.
Approved caption creates exactly one post and links the cooking session once.
Successful session link records 80 XP and the created post ID.
Browser-generated multipart Content-Type includes a boundary.
Multipart body includes the expected content and sessionId fields.
frontend.api_mode: Playwright intercepts all /api/v1/** requests with local test fixtures; the browser request is inspected before interception.
frontend.lint: passed with no ESLint warnings or errors
frontend.production_build: passed with NEXT_FONT_GOOGLE_MOCKED_RESPONSES because the external Google Font response failed Next's parser; no font fixture files were committed

backend.scope: Full Maven reactor including social unit/service tests; no live database or service deployment.

limitations: No live FE-to-Monolith post creation or persistence was exercised.
Authentication and moderation responses are synthetic fixtures in the browser test.
Kafka notification delivery, media upload, and feed visibility were not verified.
The production build used temporary Google Font fixtures because the remote font response could not be parsed.
This scoped smoke result does not establish complete social feature acceptance.
